title: Telemetry
description: One machine reading. Published on MQTT fabrica/{machine_id}/telemetria and forwarded to Kafka telemetria.bruta. Every field is required and null counts as missing. Unknown fields are ignored.

machine_id.description: Machine identifier, also the Kafka key. Safe as an MQTT topic level. Filled by the gateway for the micro:bit.

boot_id.description: Random number generated each time the machine powers on. seq and the counters restart with it.

seq.description: Reading sequence within the same boot_id.

ts.description: Reading time in RFC 3339, with time zone. Filled by the gateway for the micro:bit.

good_total.description: Good parts counted since the machine powered on.

scrap_total.description: Scrap parts counted since the machine powered on.

temperature_c.description: Temperature in degrees Celsius, within the industrial electronics range. Values outside it are sensor faults.

vibration_rms.description: RMS acceleration in g, up to the full scale of the micro:bit accelerometer.
